evidence_quotes.agenda: No their-agenda question asked anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Agenda question never asked — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception. Note: customer did express some frustration ('why would I know that, I've never packed my stuff before?') mid-call that a formal agenda question earlier might have surfaced and defused.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Delivered commit-to-rate/experience framing ('our movers are not daily contracted workers, they are the most vetted and professionally trained movers'), clear pay-less-if-faster, and validated the customer's own self-prep idea (having her assistant pre-pack) with a billing explanation — strong coverage, missing only the explicit fair-check.

top_strength: Delivered the damage-coverage and on-time-guarantee differentiators clearly and adapted the process for a disabled customer who couldn't do a video walkthrough (offered a photo-upload link instead).
coaching_note: No explicit close ask was made (call ended with 'I'll send the email and link' rather than 'would you like to book?') — also, a touch more warmth acknowledging the disability disclosure itself (rather than moving straight to the workaround) would help rapport.
